data.title: Suture materials
data.summary: Miscellaneous · Threads used to close wounds, graded from 11-0 (finest) to 3 (thickest).
data.body:
_Also called: Sutures_

Threads used to close wounds, graded from 11-0 (finest) to 3 (thickest).

## Types / variants
- Absorbable: catgut, polyglycolic acid (Dexon), polyglactin 910 (Vicryl), polydioxanone (PDS), poliglecaprone (Monocryl)
- Non-absorbable: silk, nylon (Ethilon), polyester (Mersilene), polypropylene (Prolene), polybutester
- Monofilament: gut, nylon, polypropylene
- Multifilament: silk, cotton, linen, braided nylon, polyglactin
- Natural vs synthetic

## Uses / indications
- 3-0/4-0: scalp, back, extremities, facial wounds under tension
- 5-0: face, scrotum
- 6-0: eyelids
- Most dermatosurgery uses 3-0 to 6-0

## Sterilisation & care
Gamma irradiation (factory pre-sterilised).

## Viva points & tips
- Sizes thicker than 1-0 carry the '#' prefix
- Other closure aids: cyanoacrylate glue, fibrin glue, closure tapes (Steri-Strip), staples; tincture benzoin as tactifier
